contexts.text: The heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.... The host of them are love, faith, and the knowledges thereof, which before were signified by the great luminaries, and the stars.
The host of the heavens and the stars (trampled down by the he-goat) () are goods and truths.
The armies in the Heavens who followed Him upon white horses () = those who are in the understanding of the Word as to interior things. WH 1:2.
Phicol the General of his army ()... army = the doctrinal things themselves... and also, in the opposite sense, = false, or heretical things. Explained, Illustrated.
The host of the heavens = truths.
Since army, in a good sense, is truth, it is said that he cast of the host to the earth, and then that he cast down truth to the earth ().
His army who followed Him in Heaven () = truths thence, thus those in Heaven who are in truths.
By the Word of Jehovah were the heavens made, and all the host of them by the breath of His mouth (). The host of them, or of the heaven = truths.

Since by an army is signified truths, the sons of the Kingdom, and the Angels, from the truths in which they are, are called the host of the Heavens, as in Luke; Suddenly there was with the Angel a multitude of the heavenly host, praising God (). (Further Illustrated.) The host of the Heavens (in these passages) = truths; thus the Angels, who are in truths.

I will put the camp at My house concerning the army ()... The Lord's army = Divine truths. For this reason, and also because the Lord alone fights for man against the Hells... the Lord is many times called in the Word Jehovah Zebaoth... that is, of armies. (See Zebaoth.)

Since the twelve tribes of Israel represented the Lord's heavenly Kingdom, and since tribes, and also twelve, signified all the things of faith in one complex: that is, all the truths of the Kingdom, they were called the armies of Jehovah. Illustrated. AC 3858:8.
That by armies are signified truths, Illustrated.
That armies, in the opposite sense, are falsities, Illustrated.
That the stars, which are called the host of the heavens, are knowledges, thus truths; and, in the opposite sense, falsities, References.
An army = truths and goods.
The hosts of the heavens, in the genuine sense, are truths; but in the opposite, falsities.
The host of the heavens, and the stars (), are the knowledges of good and truth.
Such were they who formerly slaughtered whole armies... SE 1783.
It was an exceeding great army () = truths and goods conjoined... An army = truths and goods.

By their armies () = according to the genera and species of good in truths... An army = the truths that are of faith. But the goods of the Spiritual Church, in their essence, are nothing but truths... Hence by an army, when said of the regenerate within the Spiritual Church, are signified the goods of truth, or goods in truth. Its being said that the Sons of Israel are to be brought forth according to their armies, is because it is said of them at the time when they will go forth from Egypt; in the inward sense, when they will come out of combats with falsities; thus after they have practised spiritual warfare. Their being brought forth according to armies properly means, that they were to be distinguished as to goods in truths, thus into classes according to the quality of good; and this in order that they might represent the Lord's kingdom in the Heavens...
I will bring out My army, My people, the Sons of Israel = that they are to be delivered who are in truths and goods... Army = all kinds of good in truths.

Because in this same day I brought forth your armies from the land of Egypt () = because there was then a state of charity and faith, through which separation took place from those who are in evils and falsities... Armies = those things which are of charity and faith.

All the armies of Jehovah went forth from the land of Egypt () = that those who were in truth from good... were taken out... The armies of Jehovah = the truths and goods that are of the Spiritual Church, thus those who are in truth and good.

As to their armies () = these distinguished according to the quality of good from truth... Armies = goods and truths. As to armies signifies that those who are represented by the Sons of Israel were distinguished according to the quality of good from truth... for all good has its quality from truth.

In Pharaoh and in all his army () = the immersion in Hell of those who are in falsities from evil... By the army of Pharaoh are signified the falsities themselves. Armies are truths from good; and thence, in the opposite sense, falsities from evil. AC 8156. AC 8188.

The chariots of Pharaoh and his army hath he cast into the sea () = that the falsities from evil, both specifically and in general, of those who are of the Church and in a life of evil there, cast themselves into the Hells at His presence... Army = falsities in general.
To the host of the heavens () = against all the goods and truths of Heaven.
All the host of them () are the Angels, in so far as they are receptions of Divine Truth... The host of the heavens = Divine Truths.
Army is the truths and goods of the Church and of Heaven. References.
By army are signified truths arranged in such an order that they do not fear falsities and evils, but repel them if they make an attack.

The number of the armies of the horsemen two myriads of myriads () = reasonings about faith alone, with which the interiors of their minds were filled from mere falsities of evil in abundance. By armies are signified goods and truths, and in the opposite sense, evils and falsities, here, falsities of evil. AE 573.

That by armies in the Word, are signified the goods and truths of Heaven and the Church, and in the opposite sense, evils and falsities, may be evident from the places where the sun, moon, and stars are called an army, and by the sun is signified the good of love, by the moon, the truth of faith, and by the stars, the knowledges of good and truth; and contrariwise in the opposite sense. Illustrated.

The armies in Heaven followed Him upon white horses () = the Angels in the New Christian Heaven who are conjoined to the Lord in the interior understanding of the Word... By the armies in Heaven are meant the Angels who are in Divine truths and goods.

I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies gathered together to make war with Him Who sat on the horse, and with His army () = that all the inwardly evil, who have professed faith alone, with their leaders and their adherents, will make an assault on the Lord's Divine Truths in His Word, and will infest those who will be of the Lord's New Church... By their armies are signified all among them who in like manner are in falsities.
By army are signified those who are in Divine Truths; thus, abstractedly, Divine Truths, and thus those who are of the Lord's New Heaven and New Church.
I saw an army on red and black horses... TCR 11:3.
The armies of the Lord Jehovih (in the most ancient Heaven). Coro 37.
What army could prevail against the enemy without a general?
Like an army of plunderers, or rebels...
Like a fight with the armies of all the nations in the world...
(Comparison with the order and subordination in armies).
The army of Jehovah is said of those who are in truths.
The host of the heavens = all things of love and faith. ( = all the truths and goods of Heaven and the Church. AE 316:16.)
The host = all evils.
Praise Him all His host = goods and truths in the whole complex.
The host of the heavens (that is, the sun, moon, and stars) = all the goods and truths that are of love and faith. AE 453:7.
The host of the heavens = the knowledges of truth and good in the spiritual man; the sand of the sea, those knowledges in the natural man.
By armies, in the Word, are signified truths from good fighting against falsities from evil; in the opposite sense, falsities from evil fighting against truths from good. Explained, Illustrated.

That they signify all truths from good, is evident from the fact, that the sun, moon, and stars, and also the Angels, are called the army of Jehovah, because they signify all truths from good in the complex; and that the Sons of Israel, because by them are signified the truths and goods of the Church, are called an army. Illustrated.
By the host of the heavens, of which he cast down to the earth () are meant the truths and goods of Heaven... AE 632:5.

That the Angels gathered together, or the consociation of them, are called armies, is because by Angels, in like manner as by armies, are signified Divine Truths and Goods, since they are receptions of them from the Lord.

The reason the Sons of Israel are called armies, in the plural, is that each tribe is called an army. Illustrated... The reason the tribes were called armies, is that the twelve tribes, taken together, represented all the truths and goods of the Church, and each tribe, some universal essential of it.

By the armies of the heavens are here meant the sun, moon, and stars, because by these are signified all goods and truths in the complex; but here, all falsities and evils in the complex... Illustrated.
When ye shall see Jerusalem encompassed with armies ()... = the Church occupied by falsities.
Thou goest not forth with our armies () = that He did not protect them, because they were in falsities of evil.
The locust, the grub, the unwinged locust, and the caterpillar, My great army that I sent among you (). That falsities and evils of every kind are signified by the army, is manifestly evident.
The host of the heavens () = falsities and evils of every kind.
